description: A sprite sheet of NINE separate game UI item icons arranged in a 3 by 3 grid, each centered in its own cell with wide empty space around it: a small glass potion bottle filled with golden honey and a cork stopper; a small pile of shiny gold coins; a brown leather adventurer backpack; a red heart; a blue mana water droplet crystal; two crossed steel swords; a glowing purple magic orb with sparkles; a round wooden shield with an iron rim; a bright golden five-pointed star, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, every icon fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background, no text, no frame, no characters

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, warm saturated palette. Do not draw this house.
